title: pydvma: a Python package for dynamics and vibration measurement and analysis
description: pydvma is an open-source Python package for dynamics and vibration measurement and analysis, developed at the Cambridge University Engineering Department. It provides a browser-based data logger (with sound-card and National Instruments DAQ acquisition), spectral analysis (FFT, PSD, transfer functions with coherence, sonograms), modal fitting, damping estimation, and noise/nonlinearity separation via the Schoukens multisine Best-Linear-Approximation method. Designed for both teaching and research use.
